integrity: Ten globally valid orbit families are written explicitly. The local combinatorial, PL-height, and parity arguments prove the infinite claim; finite verification is corroboration. No external or independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Orders below 13 and other powers of cycles are not classified; abstract isomorphism to catalogued sphere-bundle triangulations remains possible; literature coverage is nonexhaustive.
title: Third-power cycle neighborhood complexes collapse to parity-twisted sphere bundles
